item.title: Physicist develops detector capable of counting photons for quantum computing
item.description: Detecting a single photon is a challenge in itself. But what if you also want to know exactly how many photons arrive at a particular point at the same time? Physicist Erik Baalbergen is working on light detectors that can do just that. They form a key building block for the optical quantum computer of the future.

item.title: Optical experiment demonstrates the strong Mpemba effect in a single qubit
item.description: Typically, after a physical system is disturbed, it can gradually return toward a state of thermal equilibrium by exchanging heat with its surroundings. Thermal equilibrium is a state in which there is no net transfer of heat between the system and its surroundings.

item.title: Ultrafast single-qubit gates through multi-photon transition removal
中国“九章四号”问世，光量子优越性实现大规模扩展
item.description: 中国科学技术大学潘建伟、陆朝阳团队研制的新一代光量子计算原型机“九章四号”5月13日在《自然》杂志发表。该机包含8176个光学模式，较2023年发布的“九章三号”扩大逾50倍。研究团队估算，若用目前全球最快的超级计算机El Capitan模拟其在25微秒内的输出，需耗时逾10^42年，超出当前估算宇宙年龄32个数量级。

item.title: Beating the break-even point with autonomous quantum error correction
Random encoders and expurgation improve 1,873 entries of the Grassl qubit code tables
item.description: arXiv:2611.08744v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: I report 192 explicit binary stabilizer codes $[[n,k,d]]$ with $53\le n\le 254$ and $5\le d\le 13$ whose minimum distance exceeds the lower bound listed in Grassl's code tables at the same $(n,k)$: 161 codes by one and 31 by two. Through the standard propagation rules they raise 1,873 entries of the table.
